label: Add the time zone of a guild
summary: Adds column "timezone" to "Guild" when it does not have it

execute.description: add the column, with UTC for the guilds that are there
execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."Guild" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "timezone" text DEFAULT 'UTC' NOT NULL

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'Guild' AND column_name = 'timezone') AS "result"
